info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Careers Applications Documents-v3-spec
info.description: The Careers Applications Documents Retrieval API facilitates access to documents associated with job applications within the careers platform. This endpoint allows users to retrieve important application documents, enabling hiring managers and HR professionals to review candidates' submissions efficiently. Typical consumers of this API include recruitment teams and HR systems looking to integrate application tracking processes. By utilizing this API, organizations can streamline their hiring operations and make informed decisions based on comprehensive applicant documentation.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of documents associated with applications.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch all documents that are linked to various applications. It is designed to provide quick access to important documents needed for further processing or reviews.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving documents related to applications. This body must include the necessary fields as defined in the schema to ensure a successful request.

200.description: Request completed successfully and the documents are returned.

ListCareersApplicationsDocumentsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to documents in the applications service.

ListCareersApplicationsDocumentsResponse.title: Application Document Response

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the application.

resultId.description: The ID of the result associated with the application.

state.description: The current state of the application.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

audit.description: Information about the audit of the application document.

ListCareersApplicationsDocumentsResponse.description: Schema representing the response for the application document retrieval operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The name of the user who created the document.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the document was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the document creation was automated.

AuditInfo.description: Schema representing the audit information of an application document.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
